name: shatter-the-brittle-refuses-expensive-reserve-only-item-destroys-cheap-one
notes: Shatter the Brittle (tdz5of8zuz): of Craggy Fatestone (reserve 4, legal) and the opponent's Explosive Concoction (reserve 7, no memory cost: illegal) only the Fatestone is selectable. Pre-fix the Concoction was offered too.

rulesClauses: Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 1 or less or reserve cost 5 or less.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated filter for Shatter the Brittle tested "memory <= 1 || reserve <= 5" on the raw card data, where -1 means "no such cost": every reserve-only item (no memory cost), however expensive -- e.g. Explosive Concoction, reserve 7 -- passed "memory <= 1", and every memory-only item passed "reserve <= 5", so nearly every item and weapon was a legal target. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php requiring a real cost (>= 0) on the side being tested.
